```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
# Clusters on S^2 x S^2
set.seed(100)
n <- 210
d <- 3
k <- 100
nspheres <- 2
cluster1 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster2 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster3 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
clusters <- rbind(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3)
cluster1 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster2 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster3 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
clusters <- cbind(clusters,rbind(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3))

col1 <- rep("#009999", (n / 3))
col2 <- rep("#FF0033", (n / 3))
col3 <- rep("#66FF00", (n / 3))
col <- c(col1, col2, col3)
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 1:3],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = col, pch = 16
)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 4:6],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = col, pch = 16
)

dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
p_curve <- plot_mds(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, col = col, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```
```{r}
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)

grid_size = 20
bws=c(.0625,.125,.25,1,2,4,8,16,32,64)
res <- inverse_mds_bw(x = clusters, result = p_curve, grid_size = grid_size, bws=bws, dims = dims, method = "NW", angular = FALSE, plot = FALSE)

plot3d(rbind(clusters[, 1:3], res[, 1:3]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(col, multiple_reps(col_grad(length(bws)-1),grid_size)), pch = 16
)
plot3d(rbind(clusters[, 4:6], res[, 4:6]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(col, multiple_reps(col_grad(length(bws)-1),grid_size)), pch = 16
)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
# Clusters on S^2, band on S^2
set.seed(100)
n <- 210
d <- 3
k <- 100
nspheres <- 2
cluster1 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster2 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster3 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
clusters <- rbind(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3)
clusters <- cbind(clusters,r_path_s2r(n = n, r = 1, sigma = 0.10)[, , 1])

col1 <- rep("#009999", (n / 3))
col2 <- rep("#FF0033", (n / 3))
col3 <- rep("#66FF00", (n / 3))
col <- c(col1, col2, col3)

close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 1:3],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = col, pch = 16
)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 4:6],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = col, pch = 16
)

dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
p_curve <- plot_mds(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, col = col, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```
